# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 15 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** Joseph Prays for Aseneth; She Is Blessed

---

**1** Joseph saw Aseneth's distress and felt deep compassion. He said to her: 'The Lord will give you life — you have taken refuge in him.' Then he got up, went to Pentephres, and said: 'Your daughter Aseneth came to me just now, and she loves me. I don't know what has changed in her, but I love her and I want to marry her. Tell me if you are willing.'

**2** Pentephres and his wife were overjoyed. They said: 'The Lord God Most High has blessed you, Joseph — and now he will give our daughter Aseneth to you as your wife.'

**3** They brought Aseneth and stood her before Joseph. Pentephres took Aseneth's right hand and placed it in Joseph's right hand.

**4** Joseph prayed: 'Lord God of my father Israel — Most High, Almighty — you give life to all things, you call people from darkness to light, from error to truth, from death to life. Lord, bless this woman. Renew her by your Spirit. Let her eat the bread of your life and drink the cup of your blessing.'

**5** Pentephres said: 'Take Aseneth inside. Dress her in her wedding clothes and bring her to Joseph.' They did as he said.

**6** Pentephres brought them together. Joseph took Aseneth's right hand, and they sat down at the table and feasted together.

**7** After the feast, Pentephres said: 'Everyone out.' All the men left, and Joseph was alone with Aseneth and her seven companions.

**8** Pentephres and his wife stood Joseph and Aseneth together and blessed them in front of everyone. The whole house of Pentephres was full of joy.

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
